en.headline: Communications Authority fines Commercial Radio HK$120,000
en.dek: The watchdog said the AM864 English channel missed required hourly news and weather bulletins at set hours from May 2022 to April 2026 and filed inaccurate compliance records.
body: The Communications Authority said on Monday it had fined Hong Kong Commercial Broadcasting Company Limited HK$120,000 after finding that its English AM864 channel failed to broadcast hourly news and weather reports at required times for almost four years.

The authority said the breach covered 7am and the hours from 6pm to 11pm each day between 1 May 2022 and 2 April 2026, contrary to a condition of the sound broadcasting licence. Commercial Radio told the authority the omissions and inaccurate compliance reports were caused by human error and administrative lapses, and that it had restored the hourly bulletins from 3 April 2026.

The company also argued that the AM channel has a smaller audience and that other news sources are available, so the impact on listeners was limited. The authority said a four-year failure and inaccurate records submitted to the regulator were unacceptable and warranted a financial penalty under the Broadcasting (Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance.

Besides the fine, Commercial Radio must submit improvement proposals within one month to strengthen internal procedures and monitoring. At the same meeting the authority renewed a hotel television licence for 12 years and accepted the surrender of another.

zh.headline: 商台英語頻道漏播新聞天氣 通訊局罰12萬
zh.dek: 通訊事務管理局裁定，商業電台AM864台由2022年5月至今年4月在指定時段未有每小時播放新聞及天氣報道，並曾提交不準確合規紀錄。
body: 通訊事務管理局周一公布，向香港商業廣播有限公司罰款12萬元，指其英語頻道AM864台近四年未有在指定時段每小時播放新聞及天氣報道。
通訊局指，違規涵蓋2022年5月1日至2026年4月2日每天上午7時，以及下午6時至晚上11時，違反聲音廣播牌照條件。商台向通訊局解釋，漏報及提交不準確合規報告屬人為失誤及行政疏忽，並已由2026年4月3日起恢復有關時段的每小時報道。
商台亦稱該AM台聽眾較少，聽眾另有其他新聞來源，漏報影響有限。通訊局認為，違規長達四年，又向監管機構呈交不準確紀錄，情況難以接受，應按《廣播（雜項條文）條例》罰款。
除罰款外，商台須在一個月內提交改善建議，加強內部程序及監察。同一次會議上，通訊局批准一間酒店電視服務牌照續期12年，並接納另一持牌人交回牌照。
